summary: The filing is a Form 6-K submitted by Eldorado Gold Corporation, a Canadian foreign private issuer, incorporating by reference its management proxy circular for the 2026 annual meeting of shareholders. The circular covers routine items: receiving audited financial statements, electing nine directors, re-appointing KPMG as auditor, authorizing director-set auditor pay, and an advisory vote on executive compensation. It also includes a normal course issuer bid mention as other business. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC transaction, or forced management change is present. The filing is a routine annual meeting notice and proxy circular, not a special situation.
